GTA 6: How to Get the Cursed Knife | Ghost Ship Lighthouse Easter Egg
One of GTA 6's creepiest Easter eggs involves a haunted lighthouse, a mysterious ghost ship, and a unique green Cursed Knife that you can keep! But uncovering this supernatural secret requires visiting several hidden locations and piecing together a series of clues.

In this IGN guide video, we'll show you how to trigger the Ghost Ship Lighthouse Easter egg on Little Hardin Island, where to find every clue, how to obtain the Cursed Knife from a sunken shipwreck, and how to spot the mysterious ghost ship using your binoculars.

text:
GTA 6 Was the Biggest Launch in PlayStation History - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
GTA 6 had a record-breaking first week, so it's really no surprise that it's become the biggest single game launch in PlayStation's 30+ year history. More than 30 million PlayStation gamers fired the game up since launch, and the game even managed to move a few PS5 consoles as well. In related news, GTA 6's launch caused Call of Duty's player count to drop a significant 42%, and CoD may face more GTA-related competition when the PC port and online mode eventual drop. And finally, GTA 6 is having a real-world affect on strip clubs, as interest in real-life locations such as the Spearmint Rhino see a boost of activity. The Spearmint Rhino was used as inspiration for a strip club in GTA 5, and the club has even had their head choreographer learn the dances from stripper routines in GTA 6 to perform in real life.

Werwulf - Official Behind the Scenes Clip (2026) Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Willem Dafoe
Join director Robert Eggers and stars Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Willem Dafoe, and Lily-Rose Depp for a behind-the-scenes look at the upcoming movie, Werwulf.

Witness Robert Eggers’ most visceral and haunting experience yet. Focus Features presents WERWULF, a harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

Werwulf is produced by Robert Eggers p.g.a., Tim Bevan, Eric Fellner, Garrett Bird p.g.a., and Sjón. Chris Columbus, Eleanor Columbus, and Bernard Bellew serve as executive producers. It is written by Robert Eggers & Sjón.

Werwulf, directed by Robert Eggers, opens in theaters on December 25, 2026.
